title: Mall / School / recurring dream
content: Hii guys just joined. I’ve had a recurring dream about being in a mall / campus / neighborhood for a while now. Not many times but enough to make me remember details and want to go back. There are multiple levels and it feels tropical and outdoorsy in the mall area yet parts of the school feel like they’re dated back to Victorian times. It’s got elevators and stairs going up to the very cramped dorms and then a huge circular whining staircase leading down to the choir room. Every time I’m in the mall area it feels like I’m on a field trip or sitting at the outdoor tables with a bunch of strangers / friends who are also looking for a “clue” or have to cross something off their to-do list. Nearby on one side of the mall it changes into NYC streets with Nola-like parties and carriages and just so many people on the streets. On another side, I remember following the path back to a bunch of restaraunts and clothing stores that weren’t attached to the mall but had kinda a Vegas feel. Lastly I remember going into a neighborhood thats super hilly and looks like it’s still under construction but the houses are gorgeous and sit very close to each other. I went inside one that was either mine or a family member’s and it was like a life size dollhouse. So open and filled with windows and the upstairs was basically one big room. Anyway every setting is always so close in proximity and I either feel like I’m looking for something in the dream or something is looking for me. Sometimes I feel fear but mostly I just keep wanting to revisit it but I don’t lucid dream and I just have to be grateful for any time I get to dream about it haha. Anyone else have any similarities?
